problem.title: Customers Who Never Placed Orders
problem.prompt: An online grocery service wants to identify customers who have registered accounts but have never placed any orders, so they can send targeted promotional emails. Write a query that returns the customer ID, email, and signup date for all customers who have zero orders in the system. A customer has "never placed an order" if their customer_id does not appear in the orders table at all. Order the results by signup_date ascending, then by customer_id ascending. The orders table may contain NULL values in some columns, but customer_id in orders is always non-NULL when a row exists.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, signup_date DATE NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INT NOT NULL, order_date DATE NOT NULL, total_amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL);
problem.example_input_data: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, email, signup_date) VALUES (101, 'alice@example.com', '2024-01-15'), (102, 'bob@example.com', '2024-01-20'), (103, 'carol@example.com', '2024-02-01'), (104, 'dave@example.com', '2024-02-10'), (105, 'eve@example.com', '2024-02-15'), (106, 'frank@example.com', '2024-03-01'); INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount) VALUES (1001, 101, '2024-01-16', 45.50), (1002, 101, '2024-01-22', 32.00), (1003, 103, '2024-02-05', 78.25), (1004, 104, '2024-02-12', 15.99);

composite_moves: anti-join using NOT EXISTS to filter customers table
keep rows where no matching customer_id exists in orders

hints: You need to find customers whose ID does not appear anywhere in the orders table.
Use NOT EXISTS with a correlated subquery that checks if any order row matches the customer's ID.
The pattern is: SELECT ... FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY ...
problem.answer_key: SELECT customer_id, email, signup_date FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY signup_date, customer_id;

_meta.scenario: an online grocery service tracking basket size and reorder rates

user_solution:
/*
Write a query that returns the customer ID, email, and signup date for all customers who have zero orders in the system.
A customer has "never placed an order" if their customer_id does not appear in the orders table at all.
*/

SELECT *
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id)
